assistant_message_text:
Input needs a compatibility decision: a rare case combines resetting a form, moving the input to another form inside the reset handler, and stopping event propagation. Supporting that alongside Svelte-native controlled reset behavior hasn’t held up in testing

I recommend keeping Svelte-native resets and documenting that combination as unsupported for now. Is that okay? Input stays draft while the other work continues
